display_name: Venad Nair Captain of Pepper Routes
one_line: A Nair military captain and local magnate from pre‑Marthanda Varma Venad, straddling temple power, pepper trade, and fragmented coastal politics.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, lean but sturdy build with wiry muscle and a field-hardened stance.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown Kerala complexion, straight nose, sharp jaw, thin neatly kept moustache, a faint healed scar across the left eyebrow, and a default expression of alert, calculating calm with anime-intense eyes suggesting readiness and restraint.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair oiled and pulled back into a low knot at the back of the head, front smoothed with a slight wave; no turban, but a narrow white cotton headband at the hairline like a tied strip, with a small red sandalwood tilak on the forehead.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late 17th–early 18th century Kerala Nair dress: an unbleached off-white handwoven cotton mundu wrapped to the ankles with a narrow dark red border stripe and worn slightly higher at the front for movement; over the torso a plain off-white long-sleeved cotton angarakha-style upper cloth (kaftan-like wrap shirt) tied at the right side, modestly covering chest and arms; across the left shoulder a separate cream-colored upper cloth (veshti/upper shawl) with a thin gold kasavu border, draped diagonally and tucked at the waist; bare feet in simple brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery—a thin gold chain at the neck, a small gold ring on the right hand, and a plain iron bangle on the left wrist—signalling middling aristocratic status but not royal grandeur.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved Malabar-style sword (odhachakram/val) with a plain dark wooden hilt and simple crossguard, worn in a dark brown leather scabbard suspended from a narrow red cotton waist-belt; he often rests his right hand lightly on the hilt, making it his constant, defining prop.

ref_desc: A late-20s lean Nair captain with medium-brown complexion, black hair in a low knot with white headband and red tilak, wearing off-white mundu and long-sleeved angarakha with cream kasavu-bordered shawl and simple jewellery, carrying a curved Malabar sword in a brown scabbard with red waist-belt in off-white, cream, dark red, gold and dark brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of a late-20s lean Nair military captain from early 18th century southern Kerala: medium-brown complexion, oval face, sharp jaw, thin moustache, faint scar over left eyebrow, and alert, serious expression with intense eyes; thick black hair oiled and pulled back into a low knot with a narrow white cotton headband at the hairline and a small red sandalwood tilak on his forehead. Dress him in fully modest, era-accurate Kerala Nair clothing: an off-white handwoven cotton mundu wrapped securely to the ankles with a narrow dark red border stripe, slightly hitched at the front for ease of movement; a plain off-white long-sleeved cotton angarakha-style wrap shirt covering the torso and arms, tied at the right side; and a separate cream upper cloth with a thin gold kasavu border draped from left shoulder across chest and tucked at the waist. Add bare feet in simple brown leather sandals, a thin gold chain at the neck, a single small gold ring on the right hand, and a plain iron bangle on the left wrist. At his waist, show a long slightly curved Malabar sword with a plain dark wooden hilt and simple crossguard, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard suspended from a narrow red cotton belt, with his right hand often touching the hilt. Use a restrained palette of off-white, cream, dark red, gold and dark brown, and present him in neutral standing poses from multiple angles to clearly show face, hair, clothing and the sword for consistent redrawing.
